battle.name: 黑色戰爭
battle.theater: 塔斯馬尼亞島中部黑線地帶
battle.brief: 1826 年 11 月 29 日，總督喬治·阿瑟頒令把原住民視為公開敵人，殖民地全面開戰。此後英軍以第 40、第 57 與第 63 團等正規部隊、囚犯警與移民志願隊組成三路「黑線」，正面長逾 300 公里，自 10 月 7 日起向東與向南驅趕；原住民各部族則以標槍、棍棒與小隊游擊應戰。卡面這件 1500 年的西班牙輪發手槍早於此役三百餘年，仍是英軍軍官副武器的直系前身。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 交戰雙方都不屬於近代主權國家。英方是英國在塔斯馬尼亞（范迪門地）的殖民當局：總督喬治·阿瑟自 1824 年 5 月起主持軍政，之下設行政會議、常駐英軍第 39、第 40、第 57 與第 63 團步兵、囚犯警與 1827 年 9 月增設的 26 名野地警，並有范迪門地地產公司的牧人與得到政府武裝的移民志願隊。原住民一方是島上原住民族（palawa）各部族聯盟，包括大河、牡蠣灣、本洛蒙德、北部中部、帕利托雷與西北諸族，沒有統一司令部，由首領各自率領十至二十人的戰隊行動。英方起初把原住民當作治安與司法對象而非敵國；1826 年 11 月 29 日的公告首次宣告雙方為交戰關係，1828 年 4 月 19 日《隔離土著與白人住民公告》劃定定居區界線，1828 年 11 月 1 日戒嚴令則把英王置於交戰一方，1829 年 11 月成立的原住民委員會負責檢討政策。
countriesEn: Neither side was a modern sovereign state. On the British side stood the colonial administration of Van Diemen's Land, present-day Tasmania: since May 1824 the lieutenant-governor George Arthur directed civil and military affairs, assisted by an executive council, the 39th, 40th, 57th and 63rd Regiments of Foot, the convict police and the 26 field police added in September 1827, together with the shepherds of the Van Diemen's Land Company and settler volunteers armed by the government. On the other side stood the Aboriginal Tasmanian, or palawa, nations acting in a loose alliance: the Big River, Oyster Bay, Ben Lomond, North Midlands, Pallittorre and north-western groups. They had no unified command, each leader taking out war parties of ten to twenty men. The British at first treated the Aboriginal people as subjects of police and justice rather than as an enemy state. The notice of 29 November 1826 first declared open war between them, the Proclamation Separating the Aborigines from the White Inhabitants of 19 April 1828 drew the boundary of the settled districts, and the declaration of martial law on 1 November 1828 placed the King in the role of a belligerent, while the Aborigines Committee set up in November 1829 reviewed the causes of the violence and recommended policy.
people: 關鍵決策集中在總督喬治·阿瑟一身：他 1826 年 11 月 29 日頒令視原住民為公開敵人，1828 年 4 月 19 日劃界，1828 年 11 月 1 日宣布戒嚴，1830 年 2 月開出每名成人 5 英鎊、兒童 2 英鎊的懸賞，1830 年 10 月下令組建黑線，1831 年 2 月任命七人原住民委員會，1832 年 1 月撤銷戒嚴。戰術層面由第 63 團少校索爾托·道格拉斯總領黑線，以三路縱隊分進合擊。另一條關鍵人物是布魯尼島原住民傳道團團長喬治·奧古斯都·羅賓遜，他自 1830 年 1 月起率領十九名原住民談判者執行「友善使命」，以原住民身分接觸大河、牡蠣灣與本洛蒙德諸族，最終促成投降。原住民方面的首領有曼納拉根納、烏馬拉、蒙佩利亞塔、唐耶隆格特與奇卡塔普拉，其中烏馬拉之妻烏萊托皮涅勸服同伴放下武器。1830 年 3 月出任原住民委員會主席的副主教威廉·布勞頓主持了官方檢討，記者亨利·梅爾維爾則在 1835 年把「黑戰爭」與「黑線」兩個名稱固定下來。
peopleEn: Decision-making was concentrated in the governor George Arthur. He issued the notice treating the Aboriginal people as open enemies on 29 November 1826, drew the boundary of the settled districts on 19 April 1828, proclaimed martial law on 1 November 1828, offered a bounty of £5 for every adult and £2 for every child in February 1830, ordered the Black Line raised in October 1830, appointed a seven-man Aborigines Committee in February 1831 and revoked martial law in January 1832. At the tactical level Major Sholto Douglas of the 63rd Regiment commanded the Black Line, driving its three columns in a pincer. The other decisive figure was George Augustus Robinson, head of the Aboriginal mission on Bruny Island, who from January 1830 led nineteen Aboriginal negotiators on the “Friendly Missions”, approaching the Big River, Oyster Bay and Ben Lomond groups as one Aboriginal speaking to another and finally securing their surrender. On the Aboriginal side the leaders were Mannalargenna, Umarrah, Montpelliatta, Tongerlongeter and Kikatapula; Umarrah's wife Woolaytopinnyer persuaded her own people to lay down their weapons. Archdeacon William Broughton, chairman of the Aborigines Committee from March 1830, presided over the official inquiry, and the journalist Henry Melville fixed the names “Black War” and “Black Line” in 1835.
kits: 卡面這件 1500 年的西班牙輪發手槍是史上最早的後膛手槍，靠火繩帶動燧石打火，機件昂貴，只配給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵；它屬於十六世紀西班牙的軍官制式配備，血緣上早於范迪門地殖民地三百年。1826 年時這類火繩機構早已被燧發機取代，輪發手槍在英軍手中只以模型與舊式儀仗的姿態存在，真正隨軍的是燧發單發手槍，由軍官與軍士攜帶，作為滑膛步槍的側翼副武器，這正是輪發手槍傳統的延續。主戰武器是英軍制式 .62 英寸「褐貝絲」燧發滑膛步槍，配刺刀；追擊隊、巡邏隊與移民志願隊另用短獵槍、砍刀、棍棒與手槍。野地警雖有馬匹，但因馬匹不足多以徒步作戰。原住民戰隊的裝備是標槍、投矛器、石塊與棍棒，靠投擲距離與地形遮蔽壓制，並緊盯火槍裝填的間隙趁勢衝鋒。
kitsEn: The card shows a Spanish wheellock pistol of 1500, the earliest breech-loading pistol, in which a burning cord drives the flint and throws sparks into the priming pan; the mechanism was costly and it was issued only to officers and guards of the musket corps. It belongs to the sixteenth-century Spanish officer's outfit and stands three centuries before the settlement of Van Diemen's Land. By 1826 the cord mechanism had long been superseded by the flintlock, and in British hands the wheellock survived only as a curiosity and an old parade relic; what actually went on campaign was the single-shot flintlock pistol, carried by officers and NCOs as the flank sidearm of the smooth-bore musket, a direct continuation of the wheellock's traditional role. The main weapon was the regulation .62-inch “Brown Bess” flintlock smooth-bore musket with bayonet; pursuit parties, roving parties and settler volunteers also used short carbines, cutlasses, clubs and pistols. The field police had horses but fought mostly on foot because mounts were scarce. The Aboriginal war parties carried spears, throwing sticks, stones and clubs, relying on casting range and broken ground, and they watched closely for the pause while a musket was reloaded in order to rush the firing line.
tactics: 原住民採取游擊戰術：戰隊多為十至二十人，多在白天出手，以伏擊與打完即走的襲擊為主，用火堆或婦女把人誘出屋外，分成佯攻組與主攻組兩路，行動後立刻分散以免被追蹤，同時以燒屋、殺羊與砍莊稼削弱殖民者的據點；他們很快摸清火槍約三十秒才擊發一次的弱點，趁裝填時逼近。原住民一方沒有攻勢作戰，行動節奏由各首領自行決定。英方的對應是三種固定動作：其一，追擊隊追特定襲擊事件，出發後在外十二至四十八小時；其二，巡邏隊沿邊界游走十二至十八天；其三，拂曉突襲營地或依營火位置夜襲。三路縱隊、錯開配置的正面自 1830 年 10 月 7 日起推進，企圖把四個部族趕過福雷斯蒂耶半島，收束到東灣地峽，再趕入塔斯曼半島作為保留區。
tacticsEn: The Aboriginal fought a guerrilla war. War parties of ten to twenty men struck mostly in daylight, preferring ambushes and raids that ended the moment they had finished, lit fires or used women to draw people out of their huts, split into a screening group and a main group, and scattered at once after an attack to shake off pursuit, while burning houses, killing sheep and cutting crops to undermine the colonial stations. They quickly grasped that a musket fired only about once every thirty seconds, and closed in while the weapon was being reloaded. There was no offensive operation on their side; the tempo was set by each leader. The British reply followed three fixed routines. First, pursuit parties were sent after a particular raid and stayed in the field twelve to forty-eight hours. Second, roving parties worked the frontier for twelve to eighteen days. Third, they struck camp at dawn, or attacked by night once the fires had given away a group's position. The Black Line, three columns in staggered formation, began its push on 7 October 1830, intending to sweep four of the nations across the Forestier Peninsula, pinch them at East Bay Neck and drive them into the Tasman Peninsula, which was to be declared an Aboriginal reserve.
data: 可查數字集中在一八二〇年代中後期。殖民地人口由 1815 年約 2,000 人增至 1830 年 24,000 人，羊 68 萬頭、牛 10 萬頭，定居區佔島嶼土地近三成；島上原住民總數估計 3,000 至 7,000 人，1826 年殖民者估計定居區約 1,200 人，1829 年總督仍估計全島有 2,000 人。原住民攻擊密度由 1803 至 1823 年平均每年 1.7 次升到 1824 至 1826 年每年 18 次。英軍投入：1827 年 9 月增派 26 名野地警與 55 名士兵；1828 年 4 月沿邊界與定居區設 14 個軍哨，駐第 40 與第 57 團近 300 人；1829 年 3 月駐軍約 400 人，分 23 支巡邏隊共約 200 名士兵巡邏。黑線規模 2,200 人，含 550 名士兵、738 名囚犯役與 912 名平民，三個縱隊，正面逾 300 公里，1830 年 10 月 7 日啟動、11 月 26 日解散，作戰區內敵方約 100 至 200 人，其間原住民發動至少 50 次攻擊，英方唯一成果是 10 月 25 日拂曉伏擊，2 人被擒、2 人被殺。火槍擊發間隔約 30 秒，追擊隊在外 12 至 48 小時，巡邏隊 12 至 18 天。1830 年 2 月懸賞每名成人 5 英鎊、兒童 2 英鎊。1831 年原住民攻擊 70 次，造成 33 名殖民者死傷；1832 至 1834 年為 10 名殖民者與 40 名原住民。1832 年 1 月 7 日 26 人於荷巴特投降，1833 年威巴萊納聚落約 220 人，1847 年只剩 46 人。
dataEn: The verifiable figures cluster in the second half of the 1820s. The colonial population rose from about 2,000 in 1815 to 24,000 in 1830, with 680,000 sheep and 100,000 cattle, and the settled districts took close to thirty per cent of the island's land. The Aboriginal population of the island was estimated at 3,000 to 7,000; colonists put about 1,200 people in the settled districts in 1826, and the governor still estimated 2,000 on the whole island in 1829. The rate of Aboriginal attacks rose from an average of 1.7 a year over 1803–1823 to eighteen a year over 1824–1826. British commitment: 26 field police and 55 soldiers added in September 1827; fourteen military posts on the frontier and inside the settled districts, with close to 300 men of the 40th and 57th Regiments, in April 1828; about 400 troops deployed and some 200 soldiers patrolling in twenty-three parties of eight to ten men by March 1829. The Black Line numbered 2,200 men — 550 soldiers, 738 convict servants and 912 civilians — in three columns along a front of more than 300 km, opened on 7 October 1830 and disbanded on 26 November; between 100 and 200 of the enemy lay inside its field of operation, they made at least fifty attacks, and the campaign's single success was a dawn ambush on 25 October that took two people and killed two. A musket fired about once every thirty seconds, pursuit parties stayed out twelve to forty-eight hours and roving parties twelve to eighteen days. The bounty from February 1830 paid £5 for an adult and £2 for a child. In 1831 there were seventy attacks causing thirty-three colonial casualties; 1832 to 1834 cost ten colonists and forty Aboriginal people. Twenty-six people surrendered at Hobart on 7 January 1832, and the Wybalenna settlement held about 220 in 1833 and 46 in 1847.
cause: 衝突的根子在土地與生計。1815 至 1830 年殖民迅速擴張，羊群與牧場覆蓋原住民獵場，袋鼠等天然食物被大批清除，總督自己也承認原住民抱怨白人奪地、侵入獵場並斷了食物來源；英方牧人與移民擄走婦孺、動用槍械，造成報復循環，西北地區 1827 年公司牧人殺害原住民並擄走婦女，隨即引來標槍反擊與羊群被殺。1824 年起襲擊急增，1826 年 9 月兩名原住民男子因殺害三名殖民者被絞刑，同年 9 至 11 月又有六名殖民者被殺，1826 年 11 月 29 日阿瑟的公告授權殖民者對「敵對」原住民動武，等於宣布開戰。1828 年 4 月的隔離公告劃界、11 月 1 日戒嚴、1830 年的懸賞制度，把原本零星的邊疆暴力變成有法例依據的常態戰爭。
causeEn: The roots of the conflict were land and livelihood. Between 1815 and 1830 the colony expanded rapidly, the sheep and cattle runs covered the Aboriginal hunting grounds and kangaroo and other native foods were cleared away; the governor himself recorded the complaint that the whites had taken the country, encroached on the hunting grounds and destroyed the kangaroo. British shepherds and settlers abducted women and children and used firearms, which set off a cycle of reprisal: in the north-west in 1827 company shepherds killed Aboriginal people and took women, and spears answered, with sheep killed in return. Attacks rose sharply from 1824. In September 1826 two Aboriginal men were hanged for the deaths of three colonists, and six more colonists were killed between September and November that year. The notice of 29 November 1826 authorised settlers to use arms against “hostile” Aboriginal groups, which amounted to a declaration of war. The demarcation proclamation of 19 April 1828, martial law on 1 November 1828 and the bounty system of 1830 turned scattered frontier violence into a standing war with legal sanction.
impact: 這場戰爭改變了澳洲殖民地的治理方式。戒嚴持續三年多，為澳洲歷來最長；黑線之後是「友善使命」主導的收編，原住民被分隔在定居區之外，1832 年 12 月投降至 1835 年，島上殘餘人口幾乎全數被遷往弗林德斯島的威巴萊納聚落，族群與土地被拆開，1847 年聚落只剩 46 人。名稱本身成為遺產：記者亨利·梅爾維爾在 1835 年把「黑戰爭」與「黑線」定型，後來的澳洲邊疆戰爭研究以它為起點與樣板。英國本土亦起譏議，陸軍大臣喬治·默里致函提醒，若任由一個族裔滅絕，將在英國政府性格上留下不可磨滅的污點。歷史學家對其性質有兩種解讀：一派視為有組織的屠殺與族群清洗，另一派認為英廷未策劃滅族，但政策步步導向同一結果。此役建立的「以軍力清空土地、以懷柔收拾殘部」模式，其後在澳洲其他殖民地反覆出現。
impactEn: The war changed the way the colony was governed. Martial law lasted more than three years, the longest in Australian history, and after the Black Line came pacification by “Friendly Mission”, with the Aboriginal people sealed off from the settled districts. Between the surrenders of December 1832 and 1835 almost the whole remaining population of the island was moved to the Wybalenna settlement on Flinders Island, breaking up the communities and their lands; by 1847 only 46 people remained there. The names themselves became part of the legacy: in 1835 the journalist Henry Melville fixed “Black War” and “Black Line”, and later scholarship on the Australian frontier wars starts from this case as both origin and template. Opinion in Britain turned against the colony too, and the Secretary of State for War and the Colonies George Murray wrote that to allow one people to be extinguished would leave an indelible stain on the character of the British government. Historians still divide on the nature of the conflict: one school reads it as organised massacre and ethnic cleansing, another holds that London never plotted the extinction of the race even though its policies marched step by step towards the same result. The formula built here — clear the land by force, then collect the survivors by conciliation — was repeated in other Australian colonies.
result: 黑線並未達成合圍，正面在 10 月中旬就因地形與天氣斷裂，11 月 26 日解散；1831 年原住民攻擊次數由 1830 年的 250 次降到 70 次，殘存各族因飢餓、損失與低生育而無力再戰。1831 年 12 月 31 日，羅賓遜一行在內陸接觸到由蒙佩利亞塔、唐耶隆格特率領的 26 名大河與牡蠣灣族人，烏馬拉之妻烏萊托皮涅勸服他們投降；1832 年 1 月 7 日，這批人在荷巴特向總督阿瑟投降，1 月 17 日被送往弗林德斯島，1 月戒嚴隨即解除，戰爭以英方把定居區清空告終。東部自 1831 年 12 月起再無攻擊紀錄，北部零星暴力延續到 1834 年，西北一帶到 1842 年才完全停息，1836 年在克雷德爾山一帶發現的最後一家人直到 1842 年才投降。
resultEn: The Black Line never closed its pincer: the front broke apart in mid-October because of the terrain and the weather, and the force was disbanded on 26 November. In 1831 the number of Aboriginal attacks fell from 250 in 1830 to seventy, and the surviving groups, exhausted, hungry and thinned by a falling birth rate, could no longer fight. On 31 December 1831 Robinson's party met in the interior the twenty-six Big River and Oyster Bay people led by Montpelliatta and Tongerlongeter, where Umarrah's wife Woolaytopinnyer persuaded them to surrender; on 7 January 1832 they surrendered to Governor Arthur at Hobart, were sent to Flinders Island on 17 January, and martial law was revoked in the same month, the war ending with the settled districts cleared of their inhabitants. There were no further reports of attacks in the eastern settled districts after December 1831, sporadic violence ran on in the north to 1834 and in the north-west until 1842, and the last family, found near Cradle Mountain in 1836, did not surrender until 1842.
